compiled_state.title: RED: write failing tests for runner.py ledger init + cycle_num derivation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_ledger.py` covering ledger-authoritative cycle_num derivation + SHORT_CIRCUIT pre-check.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1 (partial): runner.py initialization reads cycle-ledger.json OR reconstructs from PR comments; derives cycle_num from ledger length (authoritative).

## Specific failing test method names

1. `test_init_cycle_ledger_reads_existing_file` — write cycle-ledger.json with cycles=[{cycle_num:1, commit_sha:'abc'}] in artifacts_dir; assert runner derives cycle_num=2.
2. `test_init_cycle_ledger_reconstructs_from_pr_when_file_absent` — ledger file missing + PR_NUMBER=123 + GITHUB_REPOSITORY=owner/repo; mock `reconstruct_from_pr_comments(123, 'owner/repo')` to return {cycles:[{cycle_num:1}]}; assert cycle_num=2.
3. `test_init_cycle_ledger_starts_at_cycle_1_with_no_history` — no ledger, no PR_NUMBER (or no GITHUB_REPOSITORY); assert cycle_num=1 returned, no exception raised.
4. `test_init_cycle_ledger_warns_on_env_var_mismatch` — DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE=5 in env but ledger says cycle_num=2; assert WARNING on stderr containing both numbers; ledger wins (cycle_num=2 used in downstream calls).
5. `test_short_circuit_pre_check_same_sha_with_arbiter_rulings` — ledger has last commit_sha==HEAD AND `<artifacts_dir>/arbiter-rulings.json` exists with `rulings=[{ruling:'BLOCK'}]`; assert runner.main() exits 1 (BLOCK present); assert `async_dispatch_specialists` is NOT called.

## Behavioral assertions

Mock `cycle_ledger.read_ledger`, `cycle_ledger.reconstruct_from_pr_comments`, `async_dispatch_specialists`, and gh CLI subprocess. Assert OBSERVABLE outcomes (return values, exit codes, mock-call args, stderr substrings).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 5 test methods defined with the names above
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_ledger.py -q --co | grep -E 'test_(init_cycle_ledger|short_circuit_pre_check)' | wc -l   # expect 5
- [ ] All 5 tests fail on current main (referencing `_init_cycle_ledger` not existing or runner.py still using DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_ledger.py -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(FAILED|ERROR)' | wc -l   # expect 5 or more
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_ledger.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_ledger.py

## File Impact
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_ledger.py (new, ~220 lines)
